title: DreamQAS: Learning a Decision-Useful World Model for VQE-Efficient Quantum Architecture Search
abstract: arXiv:2607.29491v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement-learning-based quantum architecture search (RL-QAS) repeatedly invokes a variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) after each gate addition even though circuit transitions and action legality are known. DreamQAS preserves these exact dynamics and learns only expensive post-VQE feedback through a recurrent ensemble that predicts a frontier-relative feedback score without requiring the exact ground-state energy, enabling uncertainty-controlled multi-step imagination. Under a common 15,000-episode budget and frozen evaluation, DreamQAS has the lowest reported mean error among RL methods on all five main molecular tasks. At fine-error targets reached by all seeds of DreamQAS and a matched non-imaginative control, it uses 1.6-2.0 times fewer real VQE calls on four tasks. Holding LiH-4q feedback-model weights fixed, its imagined-policy actor attains 0.073 mHa, versus 4.280 mHa and 4.434 mHa for greedy and beam deployment. L

translated_title: DreamQAS：学习决策有用的世界模型以实现VQE高效的量子架构搜索
translated_abstract: 基于强化学习的量子架构搜索（RL-QAS）在每次添加量子门之后都会重复调用变分量子本征求解器（VQE），尽管电路转移和动作合法性是已知的。DreamQAS保留了这些精确的动力学特性，并通过一个循环集成模型仅学习昂贵的VQE后反馈，该模型在不需要精确基态能量的情况下预测相对于前沿的反馈分数，从而实现不确定性控制的多步想象。在共同的15,000回合预算和冻结评估条件下，DreamQAS在所有五个主要分子任务上取得了RL方法中最低的报告平均误差。在DreamQAS所有随机种子和匹配的非想象对照方法均达到的精细误差目标下，它在四个任务上使用的真实VQE调用次数减少了1.6-2.0倍。在保持LiH-4q反馈模型权重固定的情况下，其基于想象策略的执行器达到0.073 mHa的误差，而贪婪部署和束搜索部署分别产生4.280 mHa和4.434 mHa的误差。
tldr: DreamQAS通过循环集成模型学习预测昂贵的VQE后反馈信号，在无需精确基态能量的情况下实现不确定性控制的多步想象，从而将真实VQE调用次数减少1.6-2.0倍，并在五个分子任务上取得RL方法中最低的平均误差。
en_tdlr: DreamQAS learns a recurrent ensemble world model that predicts expensive post-VQE feedback without requiring exact ground-state energies, enabling uncertainty-controlled multi-step imagination that reduces real VQE calls by 1.6-2.0x while achieving the lowest mean error among RL-based quantum architecture search methods.
